releases.name: pi-system-one 1.1.0
releases.body: System One decisions for Pi. Registers the system_one LLM tool (batched choice/noul/score, env config, human-readable results with full distributions). Backed by system-one-core. Tested end-to-end in Pi against TypeSafe Jev and local Reflex. Install: pi install npm:pi-system-one

releases.name: system-one-core 0.1.1
releases.body: Provider-neutral System One runtime for TypeScript. SystemOneProvider interface, SystemOne client, choice/noul/score builders with inferred answers, one HttpSystemOneProvider for any /v1/systemone endpoint (TypeSafe Jev, Reflex), fail-closed validation, MockSystemOneProvider. Tested live against TypeSafe Jev (jev-1.13.0) and local Reflex (Qwen3.5-2B), plus golden fixtures. npm: system-one-core
